Missiles incoming!|audio = BathroomApproachWave 24 1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] dialogue on Wave 24 (Formerly, [[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== '''Missile Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has a high amount of health, slightly fast speed and 25% defense. It has one ability, ''Widespread Terrorism'', where it shoots a tower in its range of 20, applying a 35% [[Damage Debuff]] to it and any other tower hit in its explosion radius of 9 for 6 seconds while also dealing 150 damage to any unit caught in the explosion. ==Logbook Description== "''Ka-boom! Missile Ducky loves anything and everything to do with explosives. The sheer joy of explosions lights up their maniacal eyes as their unhinged quacks echo across the wreckage. There isn't a single thought behind those eyes that doesn't have destruction written across it. When the topic of explosives comes up, Missile Ducky is always the first to contribute.''" ==Appearance== The '''Missile Ducky takes''' the appearance of a yellow duck with black eyes, orange feet and beak. It wields a rocket launcher which it uses to stun towers and damage units. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *As the '''Missile Ducky''' debuffs towers, it is not possible to bypass its effects entirely. **Towers which boost damage like the [[Medic]], [[DJ Booth]] or [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to partially mitigate the effects. *High DPS towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Pursuit]], [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] or [[Turret]] can be used to deal with this. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MissileDucky.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMissileDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI3.png|'''Missile Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Missile Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MissileDuckyIconIG.png|'''Missile Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Missile Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
